title: Deduplicate discovered issues by identity
description:
## Goal
Specify and implement read-path deduplication of issues discovered across workspace projects and git worktrees, keyed by issue identity, keeping the most recently changed version of each duplicated item.

## Behaviors targeted
- The same issue in a main checkout plus two worktrees appears once in `kbs list`, showing the most recently modified version.
- Distinct issues are never merged or dropped.
- Works from a parent folder of many repos with mixed worktrees.

## Open question carried from the initiative
Recency determination (issue `updated_at` field vs issue file mtime) is decided in the spec task, not here.

## Done when
- Specs-first Gherkin scenarios in `features/` define identity key, deduplication, and recency semantics, and fail for the right reason before implementation.
- Python and Rust pass the same scenarios with identical observable behavior (parity).
- `kbs list` from a parent folder of many repos and worktrees shows each issue identity exactly once.
